rows.en: Overview
rows.ne: झलक
rows.bt: Overview

rows.en: Why is responding to mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) needs important in emergencies?
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन अवस्था हुँदा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरू सम्बोधन गर्नु किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ?
rows.bt: Why is it important to address needs related to mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) during an emergency?
rows.note: T001 is reused verbatim as a cited, unreviewed clinical candidate.

rows.en: What is the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)?
rows.ne: MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MHPSS MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the MHPSS Minimum Service Package (MHPSS MSP)?

rows.en: Why is an MHPSS MSP needed?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP किन आवश्यक छ?
rows.bt: Why is the MHPSS MSP necessary?

rows.en: How can the MHPSS MSP be used?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
rows.bt: How can the MHPSS MSP be used?

rows.en: Who should implement MHPSS MSP activities?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP का गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ?
rows.bt: Who would be appropriate to implement the MHPSS MSP activities?
rows.note: The back-translation strengthens 'should implement' to 'must implement.' The revision expresses recommended responsibility rather than mandatory obligation.

rows.en: How is the MHPSS MSP structured?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP को संरचना कस्तो छ?
rows.bt: What is the structure of the MHPSS MSP like?

rows.en: Is the MHPSS MSP only for humanitarian settings?
rows.ne: के MHPSS MSP मानवीय सहायता प्रदान गरिने परिवेशका लागि मात्र हो?
rows.bt: Is the MHPSS MSP only for settings where humanitarian assistance is provided?

rows.en: Is an MHPSS needs assessment necessary to justify implementation of MHPSS MSP activities?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP का गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्नुको औचित्य पुष्टि गर्न MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्नु आवश्यक छ?
rows.bt: Is it necessary to assess MHPSS-related needs to justify implementing the activities of the MHPSS MSP?

rows.en: How can groups and persons at increased risk be prioritized and reached with MHPSS MSP activities and services?
rows.ne: बढी जोखिममा रहेका समूह तथा व्यक्तिहरूलाई कसरी प्राथमिकता दिन सकिन्छ र उनीहरूसम्म MHPSS MSP का गतिविधि तथा सेवाहरू कसरी पुर्‍याउन सकिन्छ?
rows.bt: How can groups and individuals at greater risk be prioritized, and how can the activities and services of the MHPSS MSP be brought to them?

rows.en: Key terms
rows.ne: मुख्य शब्दावली
rows.bt: Key terminology

rows.en: What criteria were used to decide what should go into the MHPSS MSP?
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP मा के समावेश गर्ने भन्ने निर्णय गर्न कुन मापदण्डहरू प्रयोग गरिएका थिए?
rows.bt: What criteria were used to decide what to include in the MHPSS MSP?

rows.en: General principles and considerations
rows.ne: सामान्य सिद्धान्त र विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: General principles and considerations

rows.en: Summary of MHPSS MSP activities
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP का गतिविधिहरूको सारांश
rows.bt: Summary of MHPSS MSP activities

rows.en: Section 1. Inter-agency coordination and assessment for the MHPSS response
rows.ne: खण्ड 1. MHPSS प्रतिकार्यका लागि अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1. Inter-agency coordination and assessment for the MHPSS response

rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors.

rows.en: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide programming
rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.

rows.en: p.33 Section 2. Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: p.33 खण्ड 2. सबै MHPSS कार्यक्रमका अत्यावश्यक अवयवहरू
rows.bt: p.33 Section 2. Essential components of all MHPSS programs
rows.note: The source describes essential components; [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] makes them mandatory, adding an explicit obligation. Revised to preserve essential importance without asserting a mandate.

rows.en: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS programmes
rows.ne: 2.1 MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, योजना र समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate the MHPSS programme.

rows.en: 2.2 Develop and implement a monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system
rows.ne: 2.2 अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणाली विकास र कार्यान्वयन गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.2 Develop and implement a monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-list candidate for code 2.2.

rows.en: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers providing MHPSS
rows.ne: 2.3 MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.3 Care for staff and volunteers who provide MHPSS.

rows.en: 2.4 Support MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers
rows.ne: 2.4 कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 2.4 Support the MHPSS competencies of staff and volunteers.

rows.en: p.44 Section 3. MHPSS programme activities
rows.ne: p.44 खण्ड 3. MHPSS कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू
rows.bt: p.44 Section 3. MHPSS programmatic activities

rows.en: Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरू र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Orient parties involved in humanitarian work and community members on MHPSS.

rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.
rows.note: Retains the supplied activity label, including its actor wording.

rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: Psychosocial support wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T099 candidate; domain review remains pending.

rows.en: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities
rows.ne: स्व-सहायता सुदृढ गर्ने र समुदायहरूलाई सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Strengthen self-help and provide support to communities.

rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Clinical wording retained from the cited unreviewed activity candidate T100.

rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities.

rows.en: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers
rows.ne: 3.5 साना बालबालिका र तिनका हेरचाहकर्तालाई सहयोग गर्न प्रारम्भिक बाल विकास (ECD) गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.5 Provide early childhood development (ECD) activities to support young children and their caregivers.

rows.en: 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Uses the existing unreviewed wording for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being from T103.

rows.en: 3.7 Promote caregivers’ mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.7 हेरचाहकर्ताको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.7 Promote caregivers' mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Caregiver-related clinical wording is retained from the cited unreviewed candidate T104.

rows.en: 3.8 Promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of education personnel and strengthen their capacity to support children
rows.ne: 3.8 शिक्षा क्षेत्रका कर्मचारीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने र बालबालिकालाई सहयोग गर्ने उनीहरूको क्षमता सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.8 Promote education sector staff's mental health and psychosocial well-being and strengthen their capacity to support children.
rows.note: Education-personnel clinical wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate T105.

rows.en: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces
rows.ne: 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: The frozen activity and safe-space labels restrict girls to adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without an age restriction. bt-divergence: The frozen labels T054 and T106 render girls as adolescent girls, excluding younger girls included in the source. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.en: Provide focused support for people impaired by distress or mental health conditions
rows.ne: तनाव वा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अवस्थाका कारण दैनिक कार्यमा असर परेका व्यक्तिहरूलाई केन्द्रित सहयोग प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: Provide focused support to people whose daily activities have been affected by stress or mental health conditions.
rows.note: The frozen population label T008 renders distress as stress, which does not reliably preserve the source concept; the draft retains that required label and preserves focused support and the alternative causes of impairment. bt-divergence: The frozen population label T008 renders distress as stress and specifies impairment of daily activities, whereas the source does not restrict impairment to daily activities. Focused support and the alternative causes of impairment are preserved. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.en: 3.10 Provide mental health care as part of general health services
rows.ne: 3.10 सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.10 Provide mental health services as part of general health services.
rows.note: The frozen activity label T107 renders mental health care as mental health services, potentially broadening care to the wider category of services. bt-divergence: The frozen activity label T107 renders mental health care as mental health services, a potentially broader category than care. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.en: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of clinical care for survivors of sexual violence and intimate partner violence
rows.ne: 3.11 यौन हिंसा तथा घनिष्ठ साथीद्वारा हुने हिंसाबाट प्रभावितहरूको क्लिनिकल हेरचाहको अङ्गका रूपमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.11 Provide MHPSS as part of the clinical care of those affected by sexual violence and violence by an intimate partner.
rows.note: The frozen activity and population labels describe people affected by the violence, which can include indirectly affected people, whereas survivors identifies people who directly experienced and survived it. bt-divergence: The frozen labels T009 and T108 describe people affected by the violence, which can include indirectly affected people, rather than specifically those who directly experienced and survived it. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.en: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions
rows.ne: 3.12 मनोवैज्ञानिक हस्तक्षेपहरूको व्यवस्था सुरु गर्ने वा सुदृढ गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.12 Initiate or strengthen the provision of psychological interventions.
rows.note: The psychological-intervention wording, including its inflection, is retained from the cited unreviewed activity candidate T109.

rows.en: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services
rows.ne: 3.13 केस व्यवस्थापन सेवामार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.13 Provide MHPSS through case management services.

rows.en: 3.14 Protect and care for people in psychiatric hospitals and other institutions
rows.ne: 3.14 मानसिक अस्पताल तथा अन्य संस्थामा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको संरक्षण र हेरचाह गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.14 Protect and care for people in mental hospitals and other institutions.
rows.note: Institutional terminology is retained from the cited unreviewed candidate T111; specialist terminology review remains pending.

rows.en: p.82 Section 4. Activities and considerations for specific settings
rows.ne: p.82 खण्ड 4. विशिष्ट परिवेशका लागि गतिविधिहरू र विचारणीय पक्षहरू
rows.bt: p.82 Section 4. Activities and considerations for specific settings

rows.en: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS considerations and support into clinical case management for infectious diseases
rows.ne: 4.1 सरुवा रोगको क्लिनिकल केस व्यवस्थापनमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष र सहयोग एकीकृत गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.1 Integrate MHPSS-related considerations and support into the clinical case management of communicable diseases.
rows.note: The frozen activity label T112 and disease label T242 render infectious diseases as communicable diseases, although infectious diseases are not necessarily communicable; both MHPSS considerations and support remain included. bt-divergence: The frozen labels T112 and T242 render infectious diseases as communicable diseases, excluding infectious diseases that are not communicable. Both MHPSS considerations and support are preserved. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.en: 4.2 Provide MHPSS to persons deprived of their liberty
rows.ne: 4.2 स्वतन्त्रताबाट वञ्चित व्यक्तिहरूलाई MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 4.2 Provide MHPSS to people deprived of liberty.
rows.note: Uses the ordinary recipient wording supplied for activity 4.2 while retaining MHPSS exactly as in this source row.
Numeric table entry retained unchanged.
